# ForEveryone Berlin — Design System

> Token-driven, digital-first design system for foreveryone.berlin. Platform-
> neutral tokens and CSS, consumed by the Next.js prototype, any framework or
> plain-CSS app, and host platforms documented under integrations/. Figma is the
> visual source of truth; this repository is the implementation source of truth.
> The brand spec is the ForEveryone Brand Book v1.0 (June 2026).

This file is the entry point for AI agents and engineers adopting the system.
Read the spec files below before generating UI, then follow the principles and
component contracts exactly. Determinism over guesswork: every colour, type
role, and component has one correct answer.

## How to consume this system

1. Import the generated CSS variables: `css/custom-properties.css` (authored CSS
   uses `var(--*)` only — never raw hex or font names).
2. Resolve tokens from `spec/tokens.json` (flattened, machine-readable). Each
   token has `name`, `css` (the custom-property), `value`, `type`, and
   `surface` ("digital" | "print").
3. Build UI from the component contracts in `spec/components/*.md`.
4. Obey the hard rules in `spec/principles.md`.

## Brand palette (approved, single source)

<!-- palette:llms:start -->
Approved brand palette (2026-10), machine-readable in `spec/brand-palette.json`. Only these are brand colours; use the `--color-brand-*` names:

| Colour | HEX | CSS variable | Class | Approved usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Orange | `#FF7A3A` | `--color-brand-orange` | primary | Mandatory accent in every layout, printed piece and social post. Never for text, buttons, links or full backgrounds behind text. |
| Lime Green | `#D4E6A8` | `--color-brand-lime` | primary | Default background. Charcoal text only. |
| Lavender | `#E5DCFF` | `--color-brand-lavender` | primary | Default background. Charcoal text only. |
| Warm White | `#FDFCF7` | `--color-brand-warm-white` | primary | Default background, replacing pure White. Charcoal text only. |
| Navy | `#1F3A6E` | `--color-brand-navy` | primary | Occasional background for covers and standout moments. White text only. |
| Teal | `#0F6E6E` | `--color-brand-teal` | primary | Occasional background for covers and standout moments. White text only. |
| Blue | `#3F00EB` | `--color-brand-blue` | primary | Flexible usage, including backgrounds and primary buttons. White text only. Digital only, never print. |
| Charcoal | `#1E1E1E` | `--color-brand-charcoal` | primary | Text and logo only. Never a full background. |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | `--color-brand-white` | primary | Text and logo only. Never a full background; use Warm White. |
| Pink | `#FADCD2` | `--color-brand-pink` | secondary | Occasional backgrounds, graphs, charts and supportive UI elements. Charcoal text only. |
| Yellow | `#FFD84D` | `--color-brand-yellow` | secondary | Decorative shapes, marks and accents on Navy or Teal backgrounds only. Never for text or backgrounds. |

Deprecated names that look like brand colours but are not:

| Deprecated name | Old value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--color-pink` | `#F39EBC` | Not brand pink. Use `--color-brand-pink` for brand work. Old value kept as `--color-legacy-pink`. |
| `--color-teal` | `#03C9D3` | Not brand teal. Use `--color-brand-teal` for brand work. Old value kept as `--color-legacy-teal`. |
| `--color-light-purple` | `#D5C5FF` | Not brand lavender. Use `--color-brand-lavender` for brand work. Old value kept as `--color-legacy-light-purple`. |

Technical, status, ramp, legacy, and print tokens are not brand colours. Do not offer them as the palette.
<!-- palette:llms:end -->

Source: `tokens/brand-palette.json`. Resolved form: [spec/brand-palette.json](spec/brand-palette.json). Guide: [spec/brand-palette.md](spec/brand-palette.md).

## Hard rules (never break)

- **Never invent hex values or font names.** Use existing tokens. To extend a
  palette, work in OKLCH: hold the hue and lightness, step the chroma, and the
  new shade already belongs to the system.
- **Never use `surface: "print"` tokens on the web** (Young Serif
  `--font-family-accent`, `--color-print-*`, `--color-doc-*`).
- **Orange (`--color-brand-orange`) is accent only**: never text, buttons, or
  links, and never a full background behind text. The only structural
  exceptions are the QR-code border and the white standalone logo icon on
  orange (no text). Orange icons always carry a label.
- **Blue (`--color-brand-blue`) is flexible on digital surfaces**, always
  with pure white text; never print.
- **White and Charcoal are text and logo only**; use Warm White for full
  backgrounds.
- **Body text is Charcoal on light backgrounds**; body line-height is never
  below 1.5; letter-spacing is 0%.

## Files

- Brand palette (machine-readable, canonical): [spec/brand-palette.json](spec/brand-palette.json)
- Tokens (machine-readable, includes non-brand tokens): [spec/tokens.json](spec/tokens.json)
- Principles (deterministic rules): [spec/principles.md](spec/principles.md)
- Component contracts: [spec/components/](spec/components/)
- Generated CSS: [css/custom-properties.css](css/custom-properties.css)
- One-prompt redesign guide: [docs/agents/redesign-from-this-system.md](docs/agents/redesign-from-this-system.md)
- Full docs index: [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md)
- Brand authority matrix: [docs/brand-book-references.md](docs/brand-book-references.md)
- Colour audit + approved pairings: [docs/color-audit-2026.md](docs/color-audit-2026.md)
- Live prototype: the Next.js app in `prototype/` (routes: foundations, components,
  patterns, brand, logo, visual-elements, print, accessibility, governance, agent-skills).

## Agent skills

Guides for AI agents (`fe-design-system`, `fe-core`, `fe-tokens`, `fe-token-authoring`,
`fe-components`, `fe-component-authoring`, `fe-a11y`, `fe-redesign`, `fe-og-image`)
under `skills/`, built to
`dist/skills/`, `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code, and `.agents/skills/` for
Cursor and Codex. They package the rules
in this file and in `spec/` for use in another project.

```bash
node path/to/design-system/bin/fe-ds.mjs skills install
```

Manifest: [skills/index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Foreveryone-berlin/design-system/main/dist/skills/index.json).
How-to: [docs/agent-skills.md](docs/agent-skills.md). Distinct from maintainer workflows in
`docs/skills/`. Codex loads root `AGENTS.md` and generated `.agents/skills/`;
Claude and Cursor use their native entry files and rule directories.
The installer creates `.agents/skills/` by default, including in new projects.
